parsed_json.sql: SELECT m.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary m JOIN activities act ON m.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = m.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5162' AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY m.chembl_id
